IGreen HRMS API (1.0)

Enterprise Human Resource Management System API

Auth

Authentication & Authorization

Login with email and password

Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns a JWT access token (15 min) and a refresh token (30 days). Rate limited to 5 requests per minute.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
email
required
string

Registered email address of the user

password
required
string >= 6 characters

Account password (minimum 6 characters)

Responses

/api/v1/auth/login

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "email": "finance@igreentec.in",
  • "password": "IGT0007"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
  • 429
Content type
application/json
{
  • "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyX3V1aWQiLCJlbWFpbCI6ImZpbmFuY2VAaWdyZWVudGVjLmluIiwiaWF0IjoxNzEwMDAwMDAwLCJleHAiOjE3MTAwMDA5MDB9.signature",
  • "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.refresh_payload.signature",
  • "expiresIn": "15m",
  • "user": {
    • "id": "user_uuid_123",
    • "email": "finance@igreentec.in",
    • "phone": "9876543210",
    • "organizationId": "org_uuid_456",
    • "permissions": [
      • "employee:read",
      • "payroll:view",
      • "leave:apply"
      ],
    • "employee": {
      • "id": "emp_uuid_123",
      • "empCode": "G S1084",
      • "firstName": "Saravanan",
      • "lastName": "G S",
      • "department": "Finance",
      • "designation": "Finance Head"
      }
    }
}

Send OTP to mobile number

Sends a 6-digit OTP via SMS to the registered mobile number. OTP is valid for 5 minutes. Rate limited to 3 requests per minute.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
phone
required
string^[6-9]\d{9}$

10-digit Indian mobile number (without country code)

Responses

/api/v1/auth/otp/send

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "phone": "9876543210"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 404
Content type
application/json
{
  • "sent": true,
  • "message": "OTP sent successfully to +91 98765 43210",
  • "validForSeconds": 300
}

Verify OTP and get tokens

Verifies the OTP sent to the mobile number. On success, returns the same token pair as password login. OTP is invalidated after one successful use.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
phone
required
string/^[6-9]\d{9}$/

10-digit mobile number the OTP was sent to

otp
required
string = 6 characters

6-digit OTP received via SMS

Responses

/api/v1/auth/otp/verify

  • Payload
Content type

  • "otp": "483920"
}

  • "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.refresh_payload.signature",

Refresh access token

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair. The old refresh token is invalidated (token rotation). Store the new refresh token.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
refreshToken
required
string

Refresh token received during login

Responses

/api/v1/auth/refresh

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 401
Content type
application/json
{
  • "success": true,
  • "data": {
    • "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.new_access_token.signature",
    • "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.new_refresh_token.signature",
    • "expiresIn": "15m"
    },
  • "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z"
}

Logout current session

Invalidates the refresh token and closes the active session. The access token will expire naturally after 15 minutes.

Authorizations:
bearer

Responses

/api/v1/auth/logout

Response samples

  • 200
  • 401
Content type
application/json
{
  • "success": true,
  • "message": "Logged out successfully"
}

Register device for push notifications

Registers a Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) token for the current device. Used to send push notifications for approvals, notices, reminders, and chat messages.

Authorizations:
bearer
Request Body schema: application/json
required
token
required
string

Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) device token for push notifications

platform
required
string
Enum: "android" "ios" "web"

Device platform

Responses

/api/v1/auth/device-token

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "token": "fcm_token_abc123xyz",
  • "platform": "android"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
  • 403
  • 500
Content type
application/json
{
  • "registered": true,
  • "message": "Device token registered for push notifications"
}

Reset password via admin-issued token

Validates a 24-hour reset token (generated by admin via POST /employees/:id/send-password-reset), updates the password, and sends a confirmation email.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
token
required
string

Password reset token from the email link

newPassword
required
string >= 8 characters

New password — minimum 8 characters

Responses

/api/v1/auth/reset-password

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "token": "a3f2b1c4...",
  • "newPassword": "NewPass@456"
}

Change password

Changes the authenticated user's password. On success, all active refresh tokens are revoked and the user must log in again.

Authorizations:
bearer
Request Body schema: application/json
required
currentPassword
required
string

Current password

newPassword
required
string >= 8 characters

New password — minimum 8 characters

Responses

/api/v1/auth/change-password

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "currentPassword": "OldPass@123",
  • "newPassword": "NewPass@456"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
Content type
application/json
{
  • "changed": true,
  • "message": "Password changed successfully. Please log in again."
}

Logout from all devices

Revokes all active sessions and refresh tokens for the authenticated user. Every device will require a fresh login.

Authorizations:
bearer

Responses

  • 401
Content type

  • "data": {
    • "success": true,
    • "message": "Logged out from all devices"
    },
  • "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z"
}

Create tax rule

Creates a generic tax rule. Supports PERCENTAGE, FIXED, and SLAB_BASED calculation types. Tax rules are append-only — deactivate old rules instead of editing them.

Authorizations:
bearer
Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
required
string [ 2 .. 100 ] characters
code
string <= 20 characters

Short identifier (e.g. PF, ESI, STATE_CESS)

type
required
string [ 1 .. 50 ] characters

User-defined tax category (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, or any custom value)

calculationType
required
string
Default: "PERCENTAGE"
Enum: "PERCENTAGE" "FIXED" "SLAB_BASED"
applicableOn
required
string
Default: "GROSS"
Enum: "GROSS" "BASIC" "NET" "CUSTOM"
isStatutory
boolean
Default: false

Mark true for statutory deductions like PF, ESI, PT, TDS

config
required
object

Calculation config. PERCENTAGE: { rate, employeeSplit?, employerSplit? }. FIXED: { amount }. SLAB_BASED: { slabs: [{fromAmount, toAmount?, rate?, fixedAmount?}] }

object

Restrict applicability by employment type, designation level range, or salary ceiling

effectiveFrom
required
string
effectiveTo
string or null
isActive

Create leave policy

Creates a new leave policy with entitlement, accrual, and eligibility settings.

Authorizations:
bearer
Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
required
string [ 2 .. 100 ] characters
leaveType
required
string
Enum: "CASUAL" "SICK" "EARNED" "LOSS_OF_PAY" "MATERNITY" "PATERNITY" "COMPENSATORY"
daysPerYear
required
number [ 0 .. 365 ]

Total leave days entitlement per year

carryForwardMax
number >= 0

Maximum days that can be carried forward to next year. 0 = no carry forward.

accrualType
string
Enum: "monthly" "quarterly" "yearly" "upfront"

How leave days are accrued over time

isEncashable
boolean

Whether unused leave days can be encashed

isLopEligible
boolean

Whether absent during leave is marked as Loss of Pay

minAdvanceDays
number >= 0

Minimum advance notice required (in days)

maxConsecutiveDays
number >= 1

Maximum consecutive days allowed per application

allowedInProbation
boolean

Whether this leave is available during probation period

genderRestriction
string
Enum: "MALE" "FEMALE"

Restrict leave to a specific gender. null = all genders.

isActive
boolean

Responses

/api/v1/leave-policies

Create leave policy rule

Adds a conditional rule to the policy. Call GET /leave-policies/rule-schema first to understand available fields, operators, and actions.

Authorizations:
bearer
path Parameters
policyId
required
string

Leave policy UUID

Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
required
string [ 2 .. 200 ] characters
ruleType
required
string
Enum: "ELIGIBILITY" "ENTITLEMENT" "APPLICATION" "APPROVAL" "CARRY_FORWARD"

What aspect of the leave policy this rule governs

conditionLogic
required
string
Default: "AND"
Enum: "AND" "OR"

Whether ALL conditions must be true (AND) or just one (OR)

required
Array of objects (LeaveRuleConditionDto)

Conditions that must be satisfied for this rule to fire

required
object

Action to execute when conditions are satisfied

priority
number >= 0

Execution order — lower number runs first

isActive
boolean

Responses

/api/v1/leave-policies/{policyId}/rules

string
Enum: "true" "false"

Set to true to finalise submission

Responses

/api/v1/onboarding/public/{token}/documents
